messages.author: bea0a325f13d3b53
messages.subject: Identifying sets and Venn (Chow-Ruskey) diagrams
parts:
Dear all,
I am wondering how it is possible to build a table that makes it
possible to show the intersections of different sets of items in
different groups (corpora). What I have is basically this:
Corp1 ItemA
Corp1 ItemB
Corp1 ItemC
Corp2 ItemB
Corp2 ItemB
Corp2 ItemC
Corp2 ItemD
Corp3 ItemA
Corp3 ItemC
Corp3 ItemD
I would now like to identify which items belong to either only
C1(only) or C1&2 or C1&3 or C2&3 or C2(only) or C3(only).
After this I would like to visualize this result in an area-weighted
Venn-diagram (or, possibly (since I have more than 3 levels) in a Chow-
Ruskey style diagram. I know that in theory this should work with
Vennerable, but I cannot figure out how I convert the table I have
into something that is usable with Vennerable.
Can anybody perhaps help me with this?
Thanks,
Marco

messages.subject: Re: Identifying sets and Venn (Chow-Ruskey) diagrams

Marco, I assume you'll need the functions setdiff() and intersect(). A quick google search turned up this page which looks like it might be fruitful:

http://www.ats.ucla.edu/stat/r/faq/venn.htm

Best of luck. Earl Brown
